sentences.text: The instant miscellaneous appeal has been filed by the claimant for enhancement of compensation awarded under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, whereby and whereunder, liability to pay compensation amount is fixed on the Insurance Company.
Since, there is no right to recovery against the owner of the vehicle, therefore, the owner of the vehicle is not a necessary party for hearing of the instant appeal.
Copy of the memo of appeal has already been served to Mr. Alok Lal, panel lawyer of the said Insurance Company in this case.
However, none is appeared on behalf of the Insurance Company today.
List this case after Winter Holidays.
In the meantime, call for the lower court records from the court below concerned.
